vikram_se: Quick -- NovaCorp's vendor risk wants concrete audit evidence for SIG/CAIQ review. POC Monday. Need to show admin logging, SIEM forwarding, retention + immutability. Can we get a 1-pager + two example events by EOD?

alejandra_sec: Yep. I'll draft. Mapping to SIG/CAIQ: admin/audit -> CAIQ.AUD/CCM-AUD, forwarding -> SIG.MON, retention/immutability -> CAIQ.RET.

nate_ops: For forwarding they asked Splunk HEC + syslog. We'll provide HEC curl and syslog rsyslog snippet. Also note mutual TLS option and egress IPs.

alejandra_sec: Example admin event (single-line JSON):
{"event_type":"admin_action","timestamp":"2026-03-10T08:12:30Z","actor":{"id":"u_999","email":"vikram@redwood.com","role":"org_admin"},"action":"change_network_policy","target":{"id":"cluster-7"},"request_id":"req_4001"}

alejandra_sec: Example detection event (single-line):
{"event_type":"detection","timestamp":"2026-03-10T08:15:45Z","name":"excessive_failed_logins","severity":"high","count":57}

nate_ops: Minimal Splunk HEC forwarder (curl):
curl -s https://splunk.novacorp.local:8088/services/collector -H \"Authorization: Splunk <HEC-TOKEN>\" -d @/var/log/redwood/audit.log

nate_ops: Minimal rsyslog snippet:
module(load=\"imfile\")
input(type=\"imfile\" File=\"/var/log/redwood/audit.log\" Tag=\"redwood-audit\")
*.* @@splunk.novacorp.local:514

alejandra_sec: Retention defaults (Hosted): API logs 90 days hot / 13 months cold; Admin/audit 1 year default (option to archive to customer S3 up to 7 years with Object Lock/GOVERNANCE); Auth events 13 months; Inference metrics 90 days. For POC we can set 6 months on request.

alejandra_sec: One-liner for procurement: \"All audit logs are encrypted in transit (TLS1.2+) and at rest (AES-256). Customers may supply an S3 bucket ARN and KMS key for archival; Object Lock supported for immutability. Audit access is RBAC-restricted (SOC/org_admin) and access to logs is itself logged.\"

vikram_se: Great. Please bundle as PDF + add mapping to SIG/CAIQ sections. Also include contact for SOC review (alejandra_sec@redwood.ai).

logbot: Exported audit sample bundle to /shared/sales/novacorp/siem-evidence at 2026-03-10T09:00:00Z.

vikram_se: Sent to NovaCorp procurement at 2026-03-10T09:12:00Z. Marking thread resolved unless they ask for network allowlist or legal retention SLA.
